summary: Iter 7 — full backend + frontend pass for off-site review tab filters & native MapView fallback. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases green for /api/admin/off-site-clock-ins covering depot_id, user_id, date_from+date_to, combined filters, legacy days param, RBAC (staff 403). Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390×844): admin-tab-offsite renders OffsiteMap web fallback ('MAP PREVIEW' card with '6 pins · 1 depot'), 1 depot chip + 2 user chips + All chips, off-from/off-to date inputs, off-apply button. Tapping a depot chip then Apply fires GET /api/admin/off-site-clock-ins?depot_id=... and re-renders rows. Setting From=2000-01-01 To=2000-01-02 fires ?date_from=2000-01-01&date_to=2000-01-02 and shows '0 results' + '✓ No off-site clock-ins.' empty state. Existing 6 offsite-{id} rows and 6 map-{id} Map buttons regression-clean. Distance formatting now shows '6324.6km' (>1000m → km) — Iter 6 cosmetic suggestion was implemented.
critical_code_review_comments: OffsiteMap.tsx Platform.OS check + lazy require('react-native-maps') is correct — keeps web bundle clean while enabling native MapView with green depot markers, radius circles, and red employee pins.

admin.tsx load() correctly threads offDepot/offUser/offFrom/offTo into the request params and is wrapped in useCallback so useFocusEffect re-fires when filters change. Note: changing a chip causes the focus-effect to re-run AND the explicit 'Apply Filters' tap also calls load() → 2 network calls per apply. Functionally correct but slightly wasteful; consider removing filters from useCallback deps and only reload on explicit Apply.
Backend filter logic is correctly additive: rng={} only falls back to days when no date_from/date_to provided; depot_id and user_id are independently AND-merged.
server.py is 1297 lines — splitting recommendation from prior iterations still pending.
